params.name: collections
params.description: Array of collection Ids to search for items.

params.name: ids
params.description: Array of Item ids to return.

params.name: bbox
params.description: Only return items intersecting this bounding box. Mutually exclusive with **intersects**.

params.name: intersects
params.description:
Only return items intersecting this GeoJSON Geometry. Mutually exclusive with **bbox**. 

*Remember to URL encode the GeoJSON geometry when using GET request*.

params.name: datetime
params.description:
Only return items that have a temporal property that intersects this value.

Either a date-time or an interval, open or closed. Date and time expressions adhere to RFC 3339. Open intervals are expressed using double-dots.

params.name: limit
params.description: Limits the number of results that are included in each page of the response (capped to 10_000).

params.name: query
params.description: Allows additional filtering based on the properties of Item objects

params.name: sortby
params.description: An array of property names, prefixed by either '+' for ascending or '-' for descending. If no prefix is provided, '+' is assumed.

params.name: fields
params.description: Include or exclude fields from items body.

params.name: filter
params.description:
A CQL filter expression for filtering items.

Supports `CQL-JSON` as defined in https://portal.ogc.org/files/96288

Remember to URL encode the CQL-JSON if using GET

params.name: filter-crs
params.description: The coordinate reference system (CRS) used by spatial literals in the 'filter' value. Default is `http://www.opengis.net/def/crs/OGC/1.3/CRS84`

params.name: filter-lang
params.description: The CQL filter encoding that the 'filter' value uses.

items.docs: Search for STAC items with simple filtering. STAC item assets include signed URLs when the number of items returned is below a certain threshold (current default is 5). For usage information and examples, see https://github.com/radiantearth/stac-api-spec/tree/release/v1.0.0/item-search

Search for STAC items with full-featured filtering. STAC item assets include signed URLs when the number of items returned is below a certain threshold (current default is 5). Implements the STAC API Item Search Specification and STAC API Filter Extension.
